trip.title: Canals to Canals
trip.subtitle: Amsterdam, Rotterdam, and Bruges, with a rental car for the two southbound days.

stops.name: Schiphol
stops.description: Land and follow the yellow train signs. The platforms sit under the terminal, so the trip starts before you see the city.
tips: Stay on the train signed Amsterdam Centraal.
Skip the taxi rank. The train is faster into town.

stops.name: Amsterdam Centraal
stops.description: The station opens onto the IJ. Drop any heavy bag in a locker if you want the ferry with empty hands.
tips: The free ferry leaves from the dock directly behind the station.

stops.name: EYE Filmmuseum
stops.description: A white building on the north bank, mostly an excuse to cross the water. The terrace looks straight back at the station roof.
tips: The ferry is free and runs about every few minutes.
Twenty minutes is enough unless a film is starting.

stops.name: The Jordaan
stops.description: Narrow canals, leaned houses, and no particular monument. Start at Noordermarkt and let the streets turn you.
tips: Thursday's market is the lively version. Other days the square is quieter.

stops.name: Café 't Smalle
stops.description: A brown café with a terrace that hangs over Egelantiersgracht. Order something small and sit until the light moves.
tips: The waterside stools go first.
Card works, but the bar still feels like a cash place.

stops.name: Golden Bend
stops.description: The wide stretch of Herengracht where the canal houses get theatrical. The walk is the activity. Look up at the gables.
tips: Stay on the east side for the longest unbroken row.

stops.name: Canal House
stops.description: A Prinsengracht hotel for the first night. Dinner can be anywhere in the nine streets. Sleep with the window cracked if the room faces the water.
tips: Ask for a canal-side room.
Trams on the far bank run late.

stops.name: Rijksmuseum
stops.description: The morning ticket, before the cruise groups. The bike tunnel under the building is the proper way in from the park side.
tips: Book the first slot.
The Gallery of Honour is the one room not to rush.

stops.name: Vondelpark
stops.description: A soft landing after the museum. Take the pond path, not the main cycle road, and sit when you find a bench in the sun.
tips: The Blauwe Theehuis is the round café if you want coffee in the park.

stops.name: Foodhallen
stops.description: A covered market hall in Oud-West. Share three small plates and leave before the after-work queue fills the aisles.
tips: Sit as soon as a table frees. Standing with hot food in the aisle is the worse version.

stops.name: Canal House
stops.description: Second night, same canal. Pack the bags before bed. The rental car is a short walk in the morning.
tips: Leave anything you will not carry in Bruges at the desk if the hotel can hold it.

stops.name: Kinderdijk
stops.description: Nineteen mills along a straight canal. Walk out until the village noise drops, then walk back the same path.
tips: The car park is before the village. The path is flat and windy.
Go early. Coaches arrive late morning.

stops.name: Cube Houses
stops.description: Tilted yellow cubes over a pedestrian street. Step into the show cube if the door is open, then the outside is the picture.
tips: The show cube charges a small fee. The street view is free.

stops.name: Markthal
stops.description: A horseshoe of apartments with a market inside and a horn-of-plenty mural overhead. Eat downstairs and keep looking up.
tips: The stalls close earlier than the restaurants.
Weekday lunch is the calm hour.

stops.name: nhow Rotterdam
stops.description: A night on the Wilhelminakade, across the Erasmus bridge from dinner. The city is the skyline from the room.
tips: Walk the bridge at blue hour.
The water taxi dock is at the foot of the hotel if you want one last crossing.

stops.name: Antwerp Grote Markt
stops.description: The car stop between Rotterdam and Bruges. Guild houses, the cathedral tower, and one proper lunch before the last motorway.
tips: Park outside the old center if the square is full.
Give it an hour and a meal, not the whole afternoon.

stops.name: Markt
stops.description: The main square, with the belfry on its south edge and carriages circling. This is the arrival picture. Walk it once before you climb.
tips: Drop the car near the ring and come in on foot.
The square is the meeting point if you split up.

stops.name: Belfry
stops.description: 366 steps and a view over red roofs to the ring canal. Go up if the queue is moving. The bells are the reason the tower exists.
tips: The climb is narrow. Turn around if you dislike tight stairs.
Tickets are timed when it is busy.

stops.name: Hotel Duc de Bourgogne
stops.description: A small hotel on Wollestraat, close enough to the square to walk back after dinner and far enough that the morning is quiet.
tips: Book a room off the street if you want silence.
Dinner reservations matter on a Friday.

stops.name: Minnewater
stops.description: The lake of love, swans, and willows. The last morning. Sit on the grass, then the trip is finished.
tips: Go before the day-trippers fill the path.
The begijnhof gate is a two-minute detour on the way in.

legs.notes: Schiphol to Centraal, no change. The line swings west through Lelylaan and Sloterdijk.
The free ferry across the IJ, drawn as the bus leg so the crossing can be a line.
Ferry back to Centraal, then a short ride toward the Jordaan.
A few canals south, no need to rush.
Out of the Jordaan and onto the wide Herengracht.
Back toward Prinsengracht for the night.
Rental bikes south through the canal belt to Museumplein.
The park gate is across the street from the museum gardens.
A short ride north into Oud-West.
Walk the bikes back, or push them. The evening is unhurried.
Rental car, first of two days. South from Amsterdam, windmills before lunch.
Same car, west into Rotterdam for the cubes.
They are neighbors. Cross the street.
Over the Erasmus bridge to the hotel on the south bank.
Rental car, second day. Antwerp is the stop between the port and Bruges.
Last motorway stretch. Leave the car near the ring and walk into the Markt.
The tower is on the square. This is a crossing, not a journey.
A last walk south through the quiet streets to the lake.
